items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: if when you were playing Woody looked at Bill Byrne and went like this — or went like this —. That was you’re fired. And then Bill would break the news to you.

ctx.x: Yeah, if you didn’t fit in with the way — if you didn’t fit in — if he didn’t like your sound, if you didn’t fit in with what he was kind of hearing in the ensemble, he didn’t fire a lot of people. He fired a couple. I think it was really just based on does this musician kind of fit in with my concept of this band. And the way you knew you were fired is if when you were playing Woody looked at Bill Byrne and went like this — or went like this —. That was you’re fired.
And then Bill would break the news to you.
